chunks.title: Streamlit Web UI Dockerfile
chunks.content:
Streamlit Web UI Dockerfile

Dockerfile for a Streamlit web UI service. Base: python:3.11-slim. Installs pip requirements, copies source, exposes port 8501. CMD: streamlit run frontend/app.py --server.port 8501 --server.address 0.0.0.0.

Decision rules:
- Use when framework=streamlit, project_type=web_ui
- Always bind to --server.address 0.0.0.0 (not 127.0.0.1) so the container port is reachable externally
- Default Streamlit port is 8501 — map to desired host port in docker-compose or Kubernetes

Trade-offs:
- Single-stage build — suitable for frontend UI services where image size is less critical
- No non-root user — add USER directive for security-hardened deployments

Anti-patterns:
- Do not bind to 127.0.0.1 (localhost) inside the container — traffic will not reach the service
- Do not hardcode --server.port if flexible port binding across environments is needed
